markdown.headingText: Course Portal: Edexcel IGCSE Science (Double Award) - Chemistry Component
markdown.markdown:
::: {.callout-note} Welcome, students! This specialized section contains core study notes, targeted practice question banks, and past exam resources specifically aligned with the Chemistry component of the **Pearson Edexcel International GCSE in Science (Double Award) (4SD0)** curriculum. ::: ## 1. Course Introduction

Pearson Edexcel International GCSE in Science (Double Award) (4SD0) is designed for students seeking a broad, dual-credit qualification in science. It encompasses core components of Biology, Chemistry, and Physics. The Chemistry component provides a thorough introduction to chemical structures, reactions, rates, energetics, and basic organic chemistry principles.

### Assessment Outline (Chemistry Component)

The Chemistry component of the Pearson Edexcel International GCSE in Science (Double Award) is assessed through a single externally examined paper. Calculators are permitted in the exam.

Assessment Paper Target Curriculum Format & Duration Marks Weighting (Chemistry)
Paper 1C (Chemistry Component) Core Chemistry Syllabus Content Written exam featuring multiple-choice, short-answer, calculations, and structured questions — 2 hours 110 marks 100% (33.3% of overall Science award)
### Syllabus Structure

The Chemistry component is divided into 4 core areas:

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 1: Principles of Chemistry States of matter; elements, compounds, mixtures; atomic structure; the Periodic Table; calculations (stoichiometry); ionic, covalent, and metallic bonding. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 2: Inorganic Chemistry Group 1 alkali metals; Group 7 halogens; gases in the atmosphere; reactivity series; extraction and uses of metals; acid-base reactions; chemical tests. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 3: Physical Chemistry Energetics (enthalpy change); rates of reaction; reversible reactions and equilibria. ::: ::: {.callout-note collapse="true"} ## Topic 4: Organic Chemistry Terminology; crude oil (fractional distillation); alkanes, alkenes; synthetic addition polymers. ::: ::: {.download-box} ### Official Academic Resources *Download the official Edexcel Science (Double Award) syllabus specification:*
Official Edexcel Science (Double Award) Specification (4SD0)
